name: v2_analyst_ebitda_quality_mix
hypothesis: EBITDA yield worked in the first run; mixing it with slow operating quality may reduce noise while staying economically coherent.
notes: Follow-up to E5wGRdrK; may correlate with quality active, so correlation gate is important.

name: v2_analyst_ebitda_sales_yield
hypothesis: Sales yield plus EBITDA yield tests whether top-line value and operating profitability jointly improve robustness without relying on EPS.
notes: Avoids est_eps to reduce direct correlation with the existing EPS active alpha.

name: v2_analyst_fcf_ebitda_yield
hypothesis: Free cash flow and EBITDA yield should capture valuation-supported cash profitability with lower EPS dependence.
notes: Uses analyst FCF total instead of lower-coverage reported quarterly FCF.

name: v2_option_pcr_oi20_positive
hypothesis: The prior put/call reversal sign failed strongly; test the positive sign with the slower open-interest measure.
notes: Only one positive put/call test to avoid over-spending simulations.

name: v2_option_skew20_positive
hypothesis: The prior skew reversal sign failed; test whether short-dated skew is rewarded as risk compensation rather than reversed.
notes: Positive skew test; stop option sign search if this also fails.
